cover.title: 5 niche ways to get recommended by chatgpt when nobody links to you

inner.title: own your brand searches
inner.body: brand search volume correlates 0.334 with how often ai cites you, in a digital bloom analysis of 680 million citations. backlinks came out weak or neutral, so the links you chased matter less than people typing your name.

inner.title: get into the roundups
inner.body: listicles and comparison articles are 32.5% of all ai citations in that same data. if no best-of list mentions you, chatgpt has nothing third-party to repeat.

inner.title: refresh the old posts
inner.body: 65% of ai bot hits go to content published in the past year. the post you wrote two years ago is mostly being skipped.

inner.title: check bing first
inner.body: 87% of chatgpt search citations matched bing's top 10 results, in a seer interactive check of over 500 citations. you optimized for google and ignored the index chatgpt leans on.

inner.title: get named in the query
inner.body: in one public tracker of 57 chatgpt conversations (directional), brands named in chatgpt's own search query made the answer 68.9% of the time. brands it only fetched made it 2.1%.
